pacing.note: few stages (scenes), constant in-scene change: element swaps, callouts, camera steps, pose changes

transitions.rule: element swap is the default; zoom-through when scale changes; push when place/chapter changes; blur-dissolve for an unrelated reset; hard cut only in fast montage

acts.rule: one dark act by default; light acts only for tangible work / document evidence / practical tips

captions.style: Poppins phrases of 2-4 words, active word bold white, spoken words grey regular, one corner-bracket keyword box per sentence that springs between keywords

voice.tone: energetic, curious, second person, short sentences; payoff holds of 24-40 frames @60

music.mood: light, steady electronic bed 18 dB under the voice; lifts at act changes and CTA

look.look: single dark stage with faint 60 px grid + vignette; flat SVG objects drawn 2.5D (ISO 30 deg, 3 face tones, contact shadows, AO, edge highlights); caption band top, stage middle, presenter bust bottom
look.typography_system: Poppins captions 68 px; uppercase tracked labels >= 30 px; tabular extra-bold hero numbers; JetBrains Mono for code/specs

video_type: 9:16 code-drawn 2.5D tech explainer with an original presenter bust
rules_inferred: caption words lead the voice by ~50 ms
visual events land on stressed words; nothing cut to the beat
presenter enters 3-7 s, changes pose every 1-2 s on phrase boundaries
every spoken number has an animated readout
